Class GainMapCodec

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.ultrahdr.GainMapCodec
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class GainMapCodec extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Splits UltraHDR JPEGs into primary/gain map parts and re-assembles tiles with integrated gain maps.

WASM instances are neither thread-safe nor allowed to hop host threads, so every lane of the internal pool pairs one interpreter instance with one dedicated worker thread that lazily creates it and never shares it. Separate instances are fully isolated (each owns its linear memory), which is what makes parallel execution sound. Tasks are routed round-robin across lanes; concurrent callers block for their own result.

Parallelism defaults to one lane per available processor capped at 4 (opt out with parallelism 1); a single lane behaves exactly like the previous dedicated codec thread. Request more or fewer lanes with GainMapCodec(String, int) (or --sink-opt threads=N on the ultrahdr sink); the shared instance from shared(String) and externally shared UltraHdrWasm instances are always serial.

Important: the shared instance is process-wide — pipeline classes (UltraHdrImageSource, UltraHdrTileSink) share it; it is never closed by them (JVM-lifetime).

    • GainMapCodec

      public GainMapCodec(String engineSelection) throws IOException
      Create a codec that owns its WASM instance(s), using the engine selected by engineSelection. Uses a single lane; the sinks resolve the core-based default separately.
      Parameters:
      engineSelection - auto, chicory, graalvm, or null for the wasm.engine system property / auto.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the WASM module cannot be loaded.

    • GainMapCodec

      public GainMapCodec(String engineSelection, int parallelism) throws IOException
      Create a codec that owns its WASM instance(s), with the given lane parallelism. 1 selects the classic serial behaviour; larger values assemble on that many lanes in parallel.
      Parameters:
      engineSelection - auto, chicory, graalvm, or null for the wasm.engine system property / auto.
      parallelism - Requested lane count; clamped to the available processors (and to 2 for GraalWasm).
      Throws:
      IOException - if the WASM module cannot be loaded.
      IllegalArgumentException - if parallelism < 1.

    • GainMapCodec

      public GainMapCodec(UltraHdrWasm wasm)
      Create a codec sharing an existing WASM instance. The caller keeps ownership of the instance. A shared instance is always serial (parallelism 1).
      Parameters:
      wasm - Shared UltraHdrWasm instance.

      public byte[] encode(byte[] primaryJpeg, byte[] gainmapJpeg, String metadataJson, int baseQuality, int gainmapQuality) throws UltraHdrException
